title: Bridge and Uniform
author: Orsen Amberdale
blurb: Bram Okafor, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
